value.rationale: The 2026 motivating paper explicitly introduces the natural \(q_n\) and \(q_{n,k}\) enumeration questions but provides no small-n table. A complete sixth-order count spanning 9,654,368 systems, stratified into five reticulation classes, is a motivated finite cutoff for an unsolved enumerative family. The values serve as exact calibration cases for potential recurrences and structural decompositions. This is not merely a known table or a cosmetic change of a proved special case; no general downstream theorem is asserted.
